desc: Indulge your crispy, creamy cravings with Nature Valley Peanut Butter Chocolate Wafer Bars. These delectable wafer bars are made with light and crispy wafers, layered with peanut butter, and topped with chocolate coating plus crunchy granola. Reach for these wafer peanut butter chocolate bars during an afternoon break. Make them your go-to for easy lunch box treats. Or take a box along to share with the family when conquering a new trail. Whether you’re heading off the beaten path or into your own backyard, our wafer bars make an ideal choice wherever you are. At Nature Valley, we believe that what you put in is what you get out. So wherever the moment takes you and your family, you can rely on our great-tasting snacks to help keep you going. Contains 5 bars.
features:
CRISPY WAFER BARS: Made with light and crispy wafers, layers of peanut butter, and a topping of chocolate and crunchy granola; A must-have for an on-the-go snack or in a lunch box

PORTABLE SNACK: Easy, wholesome wafer bars make a tasty part of snack time or an on-the-go invigorating treat; Perfect for the pantry, lunch box, and hiking trail

DELICIOUS COMBINATION: Enjoy the ideal balance of crispy and creamy texture in every bite

QUALITY INGREDIENTS: Crispy wafers with no artificial flavors, artificial colors, or high fructose corn syrup

CONTAINS: One 6.5 oz box of Nature Valley Whole Grain Peanut Butter Wafer Bars; 5 bars

BOX TOPS FOR EDUCATION: Proud to support schools and teachers as an official participating product
ingredients: Peanut Butter (peanuts, salt), Sugar, Palm and Palm Kernel Oil, Whole Grain Wheat Flour, Whole Grain Oats, Maltodextrin, Peanut Flour, Cocoa Powder, Corn Starch, Milk Powder, Salt, Honey, Natural Flavor, Soy Lecithin, Baking Soda.
